doc.brief: Specifies the granularity of font selection that is desired in a `GtkFontChooser`.
doc.md:
Specifies the granularity of font selection
that is desired in a `GtkFontChooser`.

This enumeration may be extended in the future; applications should
ignore unknown values.

features.brief: Allow selecting specific OpenType font features
features.md: Allow selecting specific OpenType font features

size.brief: Allow selecting a specific font size
size.md: Allow selecting a specific font size

style.brief: Allow selecting a specific font face
style.md: Allow selecting a specific font face

variations.brief: Allow changing OpenType font variation axes
